findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: run_audit, get_audit_status, list_audits, delete_websites, get_report, compare_audits, list_issues, get_issue, list_entities, get_entity, get_rule, list_notifications · Private data: comment_on_issue, get_entity_graph, whoami, create_api_key, send_feedback · Public sink: list_audits, comment_on_issue, get_entity, send_feedback · Destructive: run_audit, get_audit_status, list_audits, list_websites, delete_website, delete_websites, get_website_settings, get_report, compare_audits, list_issues, list_entities, get_entity, get_entity_graph, compare_entities, get_entity_findings, list_rules, get_credit_balance, list_notifications.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: run_audit, get_audit_status, list_audits, delete_websites, get_report, compare_audits, list_issues, get_issue, list_entities, get_entity, get_rule, list_notifications · Private data: comment_on_issue, get_entity_graph, whoami, create_api_key, send_feedback · Public sink: list_audits, comment_on_issue, get_entity, send_feedback · Destructive: run_audit, get_audit_status, list_audits, list_websites, delete_website, delete_websites, get_website_settings, get_report, compare_audits, list_issues, list_entities, get_entity, get_entity_graph, compare_entities, get_entity_findings, list_rules, get_credit_balance, list_notifications

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
